title: Korpus Lectures, October 6.
content: Thanks to Mark Frauenfelder atBoingBoing for the nice postabout my little mud puddle sketch.For those of you in the Los Angeles area, I’ll be doing two back-to-back lectures in one evening at the Korpus School of Art next month. The date is Thursday, October 6, from 7 to 10 in the evening.The lectures are “Imaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn’t Exist” and “Color and Light.”(Faked photo above)Since we’ve got three hours, you can ask any question you like, and I’ll try to answer it, and I’ll do a short demo following the lectures. There will be a book sale and signing to wrap up the evening. Please sign up now, as space is very limited.Korpus eventColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist PainterImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't Exist
